propositions: BindingStore.unbind() fails to remove reverse index entries when the forward entry lacks a jira_key, causing orphaned reverse keys that persist and trigger canary alerts
the reverse pop in unbind() depends on a jira_key in the forward entry that unbind() just destroyed, creating a logic error where cleanup of one index depends on the destroyed state of another
concurrent binding.json merges with merge=ours strategy can drop forward entries without corresponding reverse pop, leaving stranded reverse keys with no recovery path
rebar bridge fsck --repair flag with pre-write guards validates store integrity, refuses on non-reverse_missing_forward kinds or retired orphans, then heals via unbind() and save()
unbind() now sweeps the reverse index for residual keys pointing to local_id after the keyed pop, making it self-contained and able to clear stranded reverse entries
